summary.description: Zombie issues (90+ days inactive) now account for 33.8% of open backlog — highest on record. Only 13.9% are actively touched in the last 7 days. Despite 393 closures in the past 30 days, new issues are keeping pace. P1 bugs remain unresolved at 100+ days old.

health_score_methodology.formula: weighted average: (active × 1.0 + aging × 0.5 + stale × 0.25 + zombie × 0) / total × 100

trend_vs_prev_run.note: Open issue count decreased (bulk-close activity), but health score declined because zombie share grew significantly. 287 zombie issues vs 151 four weeks ago (+90%).

Re-triage P1 bugs #13608 (136 days) and #13193 (150 days) — both are blocking bugs in a v1-closed milestone. Either fix in v2 or explicitly close with explanation.
